name: Tank stance crit reduction aura lowers melee crit taken and prevents daze
contract: Spell 991293 is the tank-stance passive: SPELL_AURA_MOD_ATTACKER_MELEE_CRIT_CHANCE -6 (6% less chance to be critically hit by melee). Unit::GetMeleeDazeChance counts every point of that aura as 25 defense, so -6 adds 150 defense and the daze chance of a same-level attacker drops to 0. The level 60 attacker carries QA aura 25848 (Test Enemy Crit Bonus - 10%, aura 52 +10) so its crit chance sits above 6 and the 0 clamp in GetUnitCriticalChance cannot hide the reduction. Without 991293 the crit chance taken is at least 7% and the daze chance at least 1%; with it the crit chance taken is exactly 6 points lower and the daze chance is 0.

steps.label: SETUP: the attacker can crit the tank by more than 6%
SETUP: the attacker can daze the tank without the aura
991293 lowers the melee crit chance taken by 6 points
991293 makes the tank immune to daze from a same-level attacker
